summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K announcing positive registrational Phase I/II ARROS-1 data for Jideytro (zidesamtinib) in TKI-naïve ROS1-positive NSCLC, presented at the 2026 WCLC in Seoul. In 94 patients, ORR was 94% (15% complete responses) at 15.2 months median follow-up; 90% remained progression-free at 12 months, and 70% of those with measurable brain metastases achieved complete intracranial clearance. GSK plans a supplemental NDA to the FDA in 2026 to expand the label to first-line use. This is a clinical/regulatory disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or board recommendations are disclosed.
